description: Add a 3D model the user already has (a GLB from Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Blender or any other tool) to their library as a normal 3D model, so rig_3d_model, animate_3d_model and render_3d_sprites work on it like on one made with generate_3d_model. A binary glTF 2.0 (.glb) up to 40 MB with everything embedded; Draco- or meshopt-compressed files are refused (export without mesh compression). The thumbnail is drawn from the front. Give it as a public URL (best: a long base64 string is easy to garble) or as base64. Free.

glb.description: Base64 .glb instead of url (a data: prefix is stripped automatically)

name.description: What the model is, e.g. 'knight' (default: the file's name)

url.description: Public http(s) link to the .glb. Use this when the file is online

name: upload_3d_model
